blocks.html: An emergency alert beacon broadcasts your location to every TAK user on the server until you cancel it. You can set one from anywhere.

slides.title: See alerts on the map
slides.html: When any TAK user sets a beacon, the widget in the lower left of their map shows where the alert is in relation to their own marker.

slides.title: Start a beacon and pick a type
slides.html:
Tap Emergency on the TAK Tracker toolbar, then choose one of the four buttons:

  • 911 Alert — you need assistance now
  • Geo-fence Breached — a boundary was crossed
  • Ring the Bell — call attention to your position
  • In Contact — engaged with the enemy

slides.title: Slide to confirm
slides.html: Slide both switches to the right, then tap OK to initiate the beacon. It keeps broadcasting across the network until you disable it.

slides.title: Cancel the alert
slides.html: Tap the lit Emergency button again to reopen the window. Choose Cancel Alert from the drop-down, slide both switches to the right and tap OK. The beacon clears on every TAK device in the network.
